groups.sentence: Students explain and defend every part of the work they submit, including AI-assisted work.
Students understand the content and code they submit, and their work reflects that understanding.
Students do not submit work or code they do not understand, or copy and paste AI output without comprehension.
Students explain how and why they used AI, and how AI contributed to their work.
Suspected violations are handled through the Academic Integrity process.
Students lose out or take on responsibility when they do not understand the content they submit.
